name: Mei Ling Tan
bio:
Mei Ling Tan's journey into the world of motorsports finance began during her university days, where she was captivated by the blend of high-stakes competition and intricate financial management. After earning her degree in Accountancy from the National University of Singapore, she gained initial experience in a local accounting firm, quickly rising through the ranks due to her meticulous attention to detail and sharp financial acumen.

Driven by her passion for racing, Mei Ling sought to apply her skills in a more dynamic environment. She joined Iron Lynx after demonstrating a knack for identifying cost-saving opportunities and revenue-generating strategies within complex organizations. At Iron Lynx, she is responsible for managing the team's budget, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, and providing insightful analysis to support strategic decision-making. Her colleagues appreciate her pragmatic approach and her ability to remain calm and focused even under pressure. She is always looking for ways to improve the team's financial performance.

Mei Ling is known for her innovative approach to financial planning and her ability to identify potential risks and opportunities before they materialize. Her insights are invaluable to the team's strategic decision-making, helping Iron Lynx maintain a competitive edge both on and off the track. She is a true asset to the team, and her unwavering dedication to financial excellence is a driving force behind Iron Lynx's success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle auburn highlights, usually tied back in a neat ponytail during work hours.
physical.description: Mei Ling has a slender build with a focused and intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet open, even during meetings.
Keeps a small, framed photo of the Marina Bay Street Circuit on her desk.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating on complex financial data.
